option_relations.rationale: Malignant pleural mesothelioma is a distinct type of cancer originating from the pleura, not directly related to Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) which originates from the lung parenchyma.
Primary Pulmonary Sarcoma is a rare mesenchymal tumor of the lung, distinct from Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) which is an epithelial tumor.
Sarcomatoid carcinoma is a rare and aggressive subtype of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC).
Pulmonary sarcomatoid carcinoma (PSC) is a subtype of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC). The staging (IVA) further specifies the extent of this NSCLC subtype.
